branded.why: A well-sold brand, but one supermarket brand among many, no part of a food culture of its own.

about.text: An industrial pressed cheese sold under a trademark owned by Lactalis, made from pasteurised cow's milk warmed and re-seeded with starter culture, coagulated with non-animal rennet, then moulded and pressed in cloth. The name comes from a road in Craon, Mayenne.

sources.text: Its milk, process, place and trademark, from this page.
